article_title: Expert-led and artificial intelligence (AI) system-assisted tutoring course increase confidence of Chinese medical interns on suturing and ligature skills: prospective pilot study.
citation: Yang Ying-Ying, Shulruf Boaz. (2019). An expert-led and artificial intelligence system-assisted tutoring course to improve the confidence of Chinese medical interns in suturing and ligature skills: a prospective pilot study. Journal of Educational Evaluation for Health Professions. https://doi.org/10.3352/jeehp.2019.16.7
title: WKS-2RII AI suturing assessment and training system (Kyoto-Kagaku)
description: The Waseda-Kyoto-Kagaka suture no. 2 refined II (WKS-2RII; Kyoto-Kagaku) is an AI recording and analysis system connected to artificial skin for suturing/ligature training. "The performance scores of each intern were calculated by comparison (percentage) with the performance of novice learners that had been set as the internal standard in the system." It scores six aspects (time, force in tissue, judging tension, equidistance, distance between sutures, wound dehiscence) mapped to safety, quality, and efficiency domains, returns pass/fail against a total TP threshold of 70, provides reference images and parameters of experts and novices, and served in the study as a self-assessment and training tool supporting self-directed learning and discussion with clinical instructors.
requirements: Interns watch a demonstration video before practicing; a practice session requires 1.5 hours on the system
Scores are discussed with clinical instructors as the basis for feedback
constraints: The article states a total TP score greater than 70 is a passing score and less than 70 a failing score; the system is described as emphasizing safety and quality of suturing/ligature skills
target_learners: Novice medical interns in the surgical block without prior suturing/ligature training
target_learning_goals: Acquisition of suturing and ligature skills (safety, quality, efficiency) and self-assessed confidence performing them on real patients
examples: In the expert-led+AI group, 23 interns practiced on the WKS-2RII after the shared expert-led course, with 13 completing a second and 6 a third session
